title: Unified Factored Representations Resist Catastrophic Forgetting
summary: Across a one-dimensional regression task and an image-regression task, networks with unified factored representations lost less performance than fractured-entangled counterparts during repeated fine-tuning on compatible variations. The evidence is limited to the tested tasks and setups.
ai_technology: Unified factored neural representations; representation-distillation training loss
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Controlled comparisons in two domains found substantially less forgetting for unified factored representations; distillation into fresh networks also reduced forgetting.
evidence.unknown: The experiments cover selected regression and image tasks; broader architectures and continual-learning settings remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: Unified factored neural representations; representation-distillation training loss
